# Generated by ppc worldbuilder (navigation_scripts.py); do not edit by hand.
# Water access, three exclusive states (worldbuilder/coast.py computes the same sets from the map offline):
# sea coast: borders passable sea that is neither a navigable river channel (region pp_navigation_region) nor lake
# water; waterway: coastal only through river channels or navigable lakes; inland: is_coastal = no. The channels are
# sea zones, so is_coastal alone is also true on every river bank.
pp_is_sea_coast = {
	is_coastal = yes
	any_neighbor_location = {
		is_land = no
		NOT = { region = region:pp_navigation_region }
		NOT = { topography = lakes }
		NOT = { topography = high_lakes }
		NOT = { topography = salt_pans }
		NOT = { topography = ocean_wasteland }
	}
}
pp_is_waterway = {
	is_coastal = yes
	NOT = { pp_is_sea_coast = yes }
}
